scientific_integrity: One explicit theorem, analytic five-chamber proof, executable independent checking. Computations corroborate but do not replace analytical proof. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact central sections of the regular truncated octahedron only; no translated-plane result, statistical stability theorem, or priority certification. Full text of Paul (1981) was inaccessible.
title: Exact Haar polygon-type law for central sections of the regular truncated octahedron
